acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Insectoids family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Elite Drone, T3, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Spiracle-Switch Specialist (Specialist) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two earth construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Glossy fluted plating, four arms, visible lateral spiracle vents, and closed wing cases create the decisive specialist silhouette without functional wings.

Signature mechanic: Hive Breath: the four-armed Drone keeps its wing cases closed while left spiracles pull units toward a marked resin node and right spiracles push them away; opening one vent bank seals the other and exposes the matching case seam.
battlefieldDuty: Qualitatively pivot the encounter by opening alternating spiracle circuits beneath closed wing cases, switching a resin route between pull and push behavior.
constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T2 retain no wings with mineral cuffs on existing limbs; T3 retains closed wing cases as load-bearing crystal shields; T4 retains functional wings with light shale leading edges; T5 remains wingless with stratified abdomen plates and stone comb anchors.
Load paths gain sediment-layered chitin, resin-bound aggregate, crystal joint wedges, planted limb anchors, and pale fractures at the active caste tool or comb latch.
counterplay: Move with the announced pull or push, then strike the open-side case seam before the vents switch; the opposite side remains inert. Affinity signal: A mineral wedge locks the active limb or abdomen segment and turns chalk-white; break it before release or attack the unloaded opposite joint.
forbiddenTreatments: Palette-only brown chitin without strata, anchors, and changed load paths
Glow-only earth treatment without mineral construction and fractures
Invented wings on T1–T2 or T5 and prematurely open T3 wing cases
Heavy rock additions that erase segmented anatomy or caste tools
identityInvariants: Segmented chitinous body, mandibled head, compound eyes, four to six limbs, narrow waist, and rear abdomen remain legible across all forms.
Chitin brown and black mature into glossy crimson, iridescent green-black, and amber accents without replacing caste-specific limb shapes.
Chitin, resin, wax comb, translucent wing membrane where anatomically present, and amber remain distinct family materials.
Shell ridging, fluting, resin plating, spiracle vents, and comb-throne structures communicate specialization rather than generic size.
Wing state is tier-specific: T1–T2 have no wings, T3 has closed wing cases, T4 has functional wings, and the immense T5 Queen is wingless.
telegraph: Glossy ridged plating lifts along one side, visible spiracles dilate, four arms brace the abdomen, and one closed wing-case seam separates.
